question: Who was the youngest medal winner for India at the Asian Games event held in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anahat Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anahat Singh, a 15-year-old squash player, became the **youngest medalist for India** at the Asian Games 2023.
 
• She won a bronze medal in the **women’s squash team event**, showcasing her exceptional talent at a young age.
 
• Anahat Singh has previously gained recognition at international levels, including winning the **Asian Junior Squash Championship**.
 
• Her contribution to the Indian squash team was pivotal in securing a medal at the prestigious event held in Hangzhou, China.
 
• Anahat’s achievement highlights the rise of young athletes in India, especially in sports like squash, which are gaining prominence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games 2023:**

 
 
• The 19th edition of the Asian Games was held in **Hangzhou, China** from 23 September to 8 October 2023.
 
• India achieved its best-ever medal tally at the event, securing **107 medals**, including 28 golds, 38 silvers, and 41 bronzes.
 
• It was a landmark event for Indian sports, with new records set in athletics, shooting, and other disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Squash in India:**
 
 
• Squash is an emerging sport in India, with players like **Saurav Ghosal** and **Joshna Chinappa** paving the way for young talents.
 
• The Squash Rackets Federation of India (SRFI) governs the sport in the country.
 
• India has consistently performed well in squash at the Asian Games, winning medals across multiple editions.
 
 
 
• **Youth in Indian Sports:**
 
 
• India has witnessed a surge in young athletes competing at international levels in various sports.
 
• Programs such as the **Khelo India initiative** aim to nurture young talent and provide them with opportunities to excel.
 
• Talented young players like **Anahat Singh** and **Neeraj Chopra** symbolize the bright future of Indian sports.
 
 
 
• **Asian Games History:**
 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event organized by the Olympic Council of Asia.
 
• The first Asian Games were held in 1951 in **New Delhi, India**.
 
• It is held every four years, showcasing the top athletes from across Asia.
